verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents filtering traces by any span attribute and breaking out dashboard panels by an attribute. That covers ad-hoc filtering and grouping on arbitrary fields. The evidence never addresses high-cardinality fields like user or request IDs, and never says this works without pre-aggregation or defining indexes. A benchmark comment shows slower trace_id fetches than Elasticsearch, but that is a performance comparison, not a capability failure. missing for 10: explicit documentation of grouping/filtering on high-cardinality fields, explicit statement that no pre-aggregation or index definition is required, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first

citations.quote: Search and filter traces by service, operation, duration, or any span attribute.
Drill down from any panel: jump into the underlying logs and traces, break out by an attribute
Search, filter, and analyze logs with List, Time Series, and Table views.
